15-16.translation: Here is an illustration: as. These unaltered beings, beginning with the great, are as they are. He explains the parable by saying that they are distorted. They combine with the sixteen distorted transformations to create the Viraja universe. The reason for the conjunction is that the separate beings are not capable of performing specific functions with various powers. Thus, those who have followed the origin appear to have entered, and have not entered again. Where is it from? Because they existed as a cause before origin, there is no possibility of their entering into the work created here afterwards (15-16).

24.translation:
In four verses, Devakī says that there is no such thing as fear or doubt in You, to announce something: form. Whatever that form is, the Vedas call it an object. What is that thing? That, he argues, is unmanifest. The reason here is the first cause. What about atoms? No, Brahma is the great. What is the main thing? No, light is consciousness. What is the quality of knowledge like that of the Vaisheshikas? No, it’s devoid of quality. Is it the result of knowledge like that of the mystics? No, it’s unchanged. Does it result in a power disturbance like that of Pushkaraksa and others? No, it’s just being. So what is normal? No, it’s unspecific. So what is causally active? No, I’m not. The reason is by the presence alone. Anything that can be imagined to be done in this way is that you are directly Vishnu. If it is indirect, he argues, it means the lamp of the spiritual, the illuminator of the aggregate of intellect and other senses. Or it is unmanifest, that is, it is not expressed in any way. How about ? He argues that it is not so much expressed by origin as that the beginning is the beginning of all action, meaning that it is eternal. Similarly, the Brahman Jyotir rejects the individual by the four steps of country, light, quality and transformation, namely, nirguna, nirvikaram. Similarly, it rejects the individual by the special as being-only, by the general as nirvishesha, and by the action as niriham. Otherwise the same. This means that you have no doubt of fear in this way. or, even those who are the authorized souls, such as Shuka
Pandey in the commentary on the verse, Deepayasi.

25.translation: Moreover, he argues, why should one fear one who remains even after the great cataclysm? In the world of the universe. Even when the great beings are absorbed in the original being, when the subtle being enters into it, the unmanifest manifestation becomes the principal. The sense of wisdom in the infinitely principal. Thus absorbed in Me, this is to be awakened in this way later, and that is called the infinite. or the remainder-noun.
